docs.text:
These notes are mainly for my own use, and readability has not been taken into account. Considering efficiency and issues related to non - text parts, except for a few subjects that are easy to organize in plain text, most of the content is uploaded as PDFs.

This notebook is not expected to contain much in - class knowledge, because there are already enough similar materials. Its main role is expected to be the record of disciplines that are sufficiently attractive or important to the author.

It is expected to be updated over a considerable period of time: in the direction of basic mathematics，abstract algebra ，complex analysis , differential equations / mathematical foundations of computer science: information theory, combinatorics, graph theory, number theory.

docs.title: 子环，环同态与同态基本定理，理想与主理想
部署mkdocs
docs.text:
mkdocs build
git init
git add .
git commit -m "Deploy site"
git remote add origin https://github.com/your-username/your-repo.git
git branch -M gh-pages
git push -u origin gh-pages --force

遇到问题

Permission denied (publickey).

解决：

ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "your_email@example.com"
eval "$(ssh-agent -s)"
ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519

将公钥添加到 GitHub 账户

ssh -T git@github.com

git push -u origin gh-pages --force

遇到问题 gitpage仅显示根目录下的readme，没有显示site/ 原因：之前的方法是手动部署，然而手动部署应该push上去site文件夹，否则gitPage找不到入口 解决： 调整 mkdocs.yml 配置

site_name: My Docs
repo_url: https://github.com/your-username/your-repo
docs_dir: docs
site_dir: site
mkdocs build --clean
mkdocs gh-deploy --force

github-setting-pages-branch: /root 这样自动部署上去的就是site
